feeds.title: Orlando The City's Magazine » Theme Parks
feeds.description: Read articles that cover the news, and new additions to the theme parks. Founded in 1946, Orlando magazine reflects the lifestyle and interests of an upscale, educated readership. And as 'The City's Magazine,' we've grown and changed alongside The City Beautiful. The arts, dining, travel, entertainment, style, people and trends-if it's part of Orlando's lifestyle, you'll find it covered in Orlando magazine.

feeds.title: The Park Prodigy Blog
feeds.description: Michael Belmont created The Park Prodigy with one simple goal in mind, to save families time and money on their next vacation. Since 2019, The Park Prodigy has provided free theme park planning resources to over 3 million people through their theme park blog and Youtube channel. Our main goal is to help families save time and money on their vacation to the Walt Disney World Resort, Universal Orlando Resort, Disneyland, Universal Studios Hollywood, SeaWorld Orlando, and more!

feeds.title: CitySurfing Orlando » Theme Park
feeds.description: Find posts covering Orlando, the Theme parks, events, and beyond. CitySurfing Orlando is a website dedicated to both those that live in Orlando, Florida and those that are just visiting. Since 2010, we have covered the theme parks and all the other fun stuff to do in Central Florida, but we also cover events, dining, shopping, nightlife, and news of interest to those who live in the Orlando area.

feeds.title: Westgate Reservations Blog » Theme Parks
feeds.description: Discover the best foods, the best new rides and shows, and lots of hidden secrets regarding Orlando's most visited theme parks and attractions. Westgate Resorts offers spacious, luxurious, family-friendly accommodations in some of the most popular vacation destinations throughout the U.S. From beautiful studio suites on the beach to multi-bedroom villas offering ski-in/ski-out privileges, our resorts are loaded with amenities.

feeds.title: Discover Universal Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Discover Universal Blog, the place where you can find the latest articles, podcasts, and videos from the Discover Universal team. We've got guides, tips, news, and more about Universal Parks and Resorts that we hope will help you out as you plan your trip. We're excited you have joined us to learn more about what's happening throughout our destinations and to get a peek inside our universe.

feeds.title: Theme Park Tribune
feeds.description: Theme Park Tribune publishes news and reviews about the biggest U.S. theme parks, including Disney World, Disneyland, Universal Orlando, Universal Hollywood, SeaWorld, Busch Gardens, and Knott's Berry Farm.

feeds.title: Orlando Theme Park Zone
feeds.description: Orlando Theme Park Zone is an unofficial, unbiased theme park fan news source, that covers Walt Disney Company, Universal Studios, Sea World, and other theme parks. We are the newest resource online for news and information on the theme parks/attractions in the Orlando-area.

feeds.title: TouringPlans Blog » Universal Orlando Resort
feeds.description: Get Disney World and Disneyland news, tips, crowds, and attraction information from the unofficial guide to Walt Disney World and Disneyland. Our trip planning tools show you the least crowded park to visit every day, customized touring plans for visiting Disney's best rides, honest restaurant reviews, how to save on Disney tickets, the best hotel rooms to ask for, and so much more.

feeds.title: WDW News Today » Universal Studios Florida
feeds.description: Read the news, reviews, and more on theme parks in our theme park-dedicated section of the website. WDW News Today is a daily-updated resource for news and information on the Walt Disney World Resort in Orlando, Florida, and the Disneyland Resort in Anaheim, California. Through pictures, videos, and articles no other fan site brings you closer to the U.S. Disney Parks.

feeds.title: Orlando Informer Blog
feeds.description: Orlando Informer was created eleven years ago with one simple concept: you deserve to save time and money on your vacation to Orlando. Much has changed since 2011, but that mission hasn't. Our team is thrilled to offer you theme park tickets that save you time and money.

feeds.title: AllEars » Walt Disney World Theme Park
feeds.description: We fetch you the latest information on theme parks, ways to travel, tips, and more. We hope that you find the information you may want or need in planning your Walt Disney World Vacation on this site. We believe the design enhances your ability to find the information you seek.

feeds.title: Orlando ParkStop
feeds.description: We keep you up to date with the latest Orlando theme park news, ride & attraction information, videos, and theme park construction updates. Orlando ParkStop was created in January 2017 by Alicia Stella. Alicia and Ian discuss rumors and news from Orlando and around the globe, including new rides and attractions coming to Universal Orlando and Walt Disney World.

feeds.title: ThemeParkHipster Blog
feeds.description: My name is Nikky. I'm a wife, a mother, a pharmacist turned theme park blogger, and a writer who loves ALL things amusement park related! Traveling alone to the parks has changed my life and I want to show how you can create your own solo theme park memories.

feeds.title: Magic City Mayhem Blog
feeds.description: I (Mikey) started MCM as a YouTube channel featuring POVs of rides, stage shows, and other theme park-related things. Since then, it grew a little beyond the parks to covering all things Orlando and showcasing some of my own artistic and graphic design abilities. But at the end of the day, I try to provide an entertaining look at all the things you might experience here in Orlando through blog posts, videos, photos, and more!

feeds.title: Orlando Theme Park News
feeds.description: Daily news, rumors, and photo reports from all of Central Florida's theme parks, water parks, minor attractions, and more. Orlando Theme Park News is the definitive source of all major news updates and public advisories from all of Orlando's amazing theme parks and attractions.

feeds.title: Theme Park Professor » Universal Studios
feeds.description: We keep you posted on the latest happenings in Universal studios. From the newest merchandise to breaking news, Heather has spent the last 8 years covering it all for her readers. A New York native, Heather ensures she gets to the Orlando parks a few times a month.

feeds.title: Disney Parks Blog
feeds.description: This is the official blog for Disneyland Resort, Walt Disney World, and Disney Cruise Line. The mission of The Walt Disney Company is to entertain, inform and inspire people around the globe through the power of unparalleled storytelling, reflecting the iconic brands, creative minds, and innovative technologies that make ours the world's premier entertainment company.

feeds.title: My Park Tickets Blog
feeds.description: Explore articles covering theme parks, giving reviews, fun facts, tips, and more. We are the no. 1 authorized seller of Orlando attraction tickets, offering great discounts on all theme park tickets. At My Park Tickets, enjoy excellent customer service, and no hidden fees.

feeds.title: Undercover Tourist Blog » Orlando Theme Parks
feeds.description: Stay updated on the timings, news, and new attractions in the theme parks. Undercover Tourist is the leading supplier of online discount tickets to Orlando, Florida-area attractions, including Walt Disney World Resort, Universal Orlando Resort, SeaWorld Orlando, LEGOLAND Florida Resort, and more.

feeds.title: Theme Park Tourist
feeds.description: Theme Park Tourist is your essential source for news, reviews, and park guides for theme parks in Orlando, Florida, and beyond. We offer a unique perspective on all the latest news from Walt Disney World, Universal Orlando, and other parks and resorts. We are proud to deliver some of the most in-depth, well-researched articles about theme parks available anywhere on the web.
